en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a substantial stone building in Romanesque style with arched entryways and tall rectangular windows. The structure is identified as a Carnegie Library. Trees and a few small plants surround the building, and the foreground shows a simple dirt or paved street. Printed caption text appears at the bottom edge, and there are also handwritten red numbers/initials over the caption area.
